rules.name: grasa-pge-pie-months-cfs
rules.sql: WITH vd AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT c.contract_month, c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu AND upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'PGE' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM S' ) SELECT sec.contract_month, split_part(sec.contract_month, '.', 2) AS legacy_suffix, si.underlying1_id, si.derivative_type, count(*) AS securities, max(u1.settle_value) AS underlying_price, min(u1.settle_value) AS underlying_price_min FROM sec JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(si.business_unit) = :bu AND si.security_id = sec.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id AND u1.value_date = :cob GROUP BY sec.contract_month, si.underlying1_id, si.derivative_type ORDER BY split_part(sec.contract_month, '.', 2), sec.contract_month, si.underlying1_id, si.derivative_type

SELECT contract_month, SUBSTRING_INDEX(contract_month, '.', -1) AS legacy_suffix, COUNT(DISTINCT security_id) AS securities FROM dbsystemuat.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE SUBSTRING(contract_number, 1, 3) = 'PGE' AND product_code = 'CM S' GROUP BY contract_month ORDER BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(contract_month, '.', -1), contract_month
